explanation: I found no Mathlib declaration matching this theorem. It says that applying the Hecke operator T_ℓ to the level-raised form `raise f` of a normalized eigenform multiplies it by the ℓ-th q-coefficient of f. Every notion in the statement belongs to the library: `CuspForm.heckeTLin`, `CuspForm.IsNormalizedEigenform` and `raise`. The proof uses only the library's own lemmas plus generic function-coercion steps. I searched `Mathlib/NumberTheory/ModularForms` for `Hecke`, `heckeT` and `IsNormalizedEigenform`. Mathlib at this version has no Hecke operators on modular forms and no notion of eigenform. The only hit was "Hecke's bound" for cusp-form coefficients (in `Bounds.lean`), which is a different result.
